summary: Umatilla County, OR lookout site on the Umatilla National Forest, listed as abandoned; forest maps showed an emergency lookout station through at least 1948. No build details found.

facts.status_note: Both listings say abandoned; neither says whether any structure remains

events.note: Shown on Forest maps as an emergency lookout station through at least 1948

evidence.supports: lookout site on the Umatilla National Forest
about eight miles northeast of Ukiah
only dated entry is 1931, with no details
shown on Forest maps as an emergency lookout station through at least 1948
evidence.quote: Shown on Forest maps as an emergency lookout station through at least 1948

evidence.supports: association places the site at 45.19180, -118.79310 with unknown type and abandoned status

corrections.why: Both listings say abandoned, not gone, and neither says whether any structure remains on the site.

notes_for_editor: Only one detailed page exists (Fire Lookout.com, Rex Kamstra); the FFLA list adds the type and status only. The forest maps the page mentions were not located. A Umatilla National Forest history archive (fs.usda.gov discover-history) appeared in search results but was not read. Build date, builder and design remain unknown.
